# Fixture for PERF-PY-23 (safe)
lang: python
file: app/export.py
---
def encode_record(record):
    # Fixed schema for homogeneous records (no per-field type walk).
    return "%s|%s|%s" % (record["id"], record["name"], record["score"])

def export_records(records):
    payloads = []
    for record in records:
        payloads.append(encode_record(record))
    return payloads
